meta.name: google-ads-landing
meta.description: Score and diagnose Google Ads landing pages. Use when asked to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, diagnose high-CTR but low-conversion-rate ad groups, improve Quality Score's Landing Page Experience component, or compare an ad group's messaging against its landing page. Trigger on "landing page audit", "landing page score", "landing page quality", "why is my conversion rate low", "LPX", "landing page experience", "ad to page match", or when `/google-ads-audit` surfaces a high-CTR / low-CVR ad group.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断谷歌广告落地页质量并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在投放谷歌广告，想提升落地页体验和转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Google Ads landing page quality and get optimization tips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Google Ads and want to improve landing page experience and conversion rates.

howto.what: Claude 会抓取目标落地页,结合广告文案与转化数据,按 5 个维度打分,并给出改进清单;若有单位经济数据,还会估算每月利润提升。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计落地页、检查落地页质量,或提到“landing page audit”“LPX”等触发词时;也会在 /google-ads-audit 发现高点击低转化广告组时自动接手。

say.note: Claude 会抓取页面并按五个维度打分

say.text: 为什么我的广告点击率高但转化低?
say.note: Claude 会检查广告文案与落地页是否匹配

say.text: 对比这个广告组的文案和它的落地页
say.note: Claude 会读取广告标题和页面 H1 判断匹配度

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the target landing page, pulls ad copy and conversion data, scores it across 5 weighted dimensions, and outputs a prioritized fix list; if unit economics are provided, it also estimates monthly profit lift.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, or says phrases like "landing page audit" or "LPX"; also auto-handles when /google-ads-audit flags high-CTR/low-CVR ad groups.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch the page and score it across five dimensions.

say_en.text: Why is my ad CTR high but conversion rate low?
say_en.note: Claude will check whether the ad copy and landing page match.

say_en.text: Compare this ad group's copy with its landing page
say_en.note: Claude will read the ad headline and page H1 to judge match.
